notes.title: Biomes 2 + 3, and current status of the studio.
notes.content:
This update includes the next two biomes, the mlug biome and the shell biome. This will probably be the last major update for a while as I am looking to move on from this passion project. Hopefully you'll see another game from me soon(1-3 years..?), for now I am looking to take a hiatus from solo game dev but I definitely will return. Thank you all for supporting me through my Game Dev journey. 

-Meowtthews
